name: UFOroid
source_text: When this card is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon from your Deck 1 Machine-Type monster with an ATK of 1500 or less in face-up Attack Position. Then shuffle your Deck.
notes: Recruits a Machine monster with ATK <= 1500 in face-up Attack Position.
